title: Remove extra cursor character from streamed Chat text
goal: Ensure the Chat streaming bubble renders only assistant response content and does not append a literal cursor character to the user's visible response.
context: StreamingChatBubble appended the literal glyph ▍ to content while a response was streaming, which looked like an extra character in the Chat answer. The fix is presentation-only and must not alter provider output or persisted turns.
forbidden_changes: Do not change provider response content, streaming assembly, or persisted conversation turns.
Do not redesign the Chat UI or change unrelated components.
Do not claim device verification when only CI evidence is available.
acceptance_criteria: StreamingChatBubble renders the current response content without appending a literal ▍ glyph.
The change is limited to the Chat presentation and its task contract.
All required CI gates pass on the final commit; physical-device testing is recorded separately.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, validate-contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: Revert the single logical task commit if the streaming bubble's visible content regresses.
